task_description: Build a complete public school website for शासकीय माध्यमिक व उच्च माध्यमिक आश्रमशाळा पाथरज with 7 public pages (Home, About, Academics, Admission, Hostel, Gallery, Contact), dark cinematic pomegranate/crimson design theme, React Router for URL-based navigation, and the existing admin portal behind login.
